name: a temperature gauge card proves the device stays cool
looks: Beneath the floating closed device, a small card slides up showing a horizontal gauge bar coloured green to red with two threshold marks, a big current-temperature number, and three small status chips underneath.
build: data-infographic's bar pattern turned into a threshold gauge: the coloured bar fills to a fixed width (not animated per se, a static gradient fill), a small marker ticks to its live position, the number rolling up to its value; the chips fade in staggered beneath.
sound: A soft whoosh as the card slides up, a tick as the number settles.
prompt: Slide up a small stat card beneath a hero product shot showing a coloured threshold gauge bar with a marker at its current position, a big number rolling up beside it, and two or three small status chips underneath. Use it to make an invisible claim (stays cool, runs efficiently) visible as a real measurement.
